title: Pure Amazement
summary: Amazement cards with the Attraction Traps they set and move around, plus generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Each Attraction Trap equips to either an Amazement monster or an opponent's monster, with a different effect for each side. Amazement Attendant Comica Sets an Attraction from the Deck, and Comica and Bufo move Attractions between monsters on either turn. Amazement Precious Park lets you activate an Attraction the turn it is Set. Amazing Time Ticket searches an Amazement card on your turn or Sets a live Attraction on theirs. Amazement Administrator Arlekino summons itself whenever a Trap is activated, equips Attractions to their new monsters, and banishes Attractions to destroy cards. Amazement Abomination Arlekino, the newest card, summons itself and searches Amazement Family Faces, which steals a monster wearing your Attraction. On their turn it swaps itself for Administrator Arlekino and zeroes a monster's ATK.

main: Amazement Attendant Comica
Starter: Sets an Attraction Trap from the Deck; moves Attractions.
Amazement Abomination Arlekino
Newest: summons itself and searches Family Faces; becomes Administrator on their turn.
Amazement Administrator Arlekino
Summons itself on a Trap; equips Attractions to their monsters; destroys cards.
Amazement Assistant Delia
Summons itself; swaps an Attraction for another from the Deck.
Amazement Ambassador Bufo
Equips an Attraction from the GY; moves Attractions.
Amazing Time Ticket
Searches an Amazement card, or Sets a live Attraction on their turn.
Amazement Precious Park
Field Spell: Attractions are live the turn they are Set; recycles them.
Amazement Special Show
Quick-Play: dodges targeting and swaps in another Amazement.
Amazement Family Faces
Steals a monster wearing your Attraction.
Amaze Attraction Majestic Merry-Go-Round
Pumps and protects your monster, or shrinks theirs.
Amaze Attraction Horror House
Negates their monster, or flips theirs face-down.
Amaze Attraction Cyclo-Coaster
Sends their Spell/Trap to the GY, or searches an Amazement.
Amaze Attraction Thrill Train
Resets an Attraction from the GY, or banishes their monster until the End Phase.
Amaze Attraction Viking Vortex
Negates an attack, or bounces their monster when it activates.
Amaze Attraction Wonder Wheel
Cycles a card, or swaps their monster's ATK and DEF.
Amaze Attraction Rapid Racing
Shuffles a card from their GY into the Deck, or changes their monster's position.
